description: Status for the active part: id, name, editor script, runState (not_run_yet | ok | failed), and the last run volume/bbox/bodyCount when available. Updates when the active part changes without requiring another run. unjointedParts lists part ids in no joint when the assembly has two or more parts (empty for a single part; a base part with a fixed joint is omitted). featureCount counts insert_* feature blocks, so a freehand set_script is one feature. bodyCount is null until the first run; a finished run that produced no bodies reports 0. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script). This process also adds webhookRegistered (true when a prompt webhook is registered; the URL and any bearer are not included), queued (prompt messages waiting for read_messages; cancelled prompts are not counted), counts ({ queued, delivered, replied, cancelled }), and last ({ id, state } of the latest prompt, or null).

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: status
